author: juliusmarminge
body: ## Summary - Replaced recoverable `Effect.catch` fallbacks with `Effect.orElseSucceed` across desktop, server, relay, and shared runtime code. - Simplified a large number of error-handling paths that intentionally degrade to safe defaults like `null`, `false`, empty arrays, or cached fallback values. - Tightened the server package TypeScript setup by removing the Bun type dependency from `apps/server` and pinning `@types/bun` where needed. - Updated a small set of tests and build scripts to match the new fallback style and workspace configuration. ## Testing - Not run. - Expected checks for this branch: `vp check`, `vp run typecheck`. - If native mobile code is affected, also run `vp run lint:mobile`. --- > [!NOTE] > **Low Risk** > Behavior-preserving API style change with no auth or data-model changes; minor TS config risk around Bun types in the server PTY layer. > > **Overview** > Replaces recoverable **`Effect.catch(() => Effect.succeed(...))`** fallbacks with **`Effect.orElseSucceed(() => ...)`** across desktop, server, relay, shared Tailscale, and build scripts. Fallback values and degradation behavior stay the same (defaults like `null`, `false`, empty collections, and safe HTTP error responses). > > **TypeScript / workspace:** `apps/server` drops global **`bun`** types from `tsconfig.json` and pins **`@types/bun@1.3.14`** in devDependencies; **`BunPTY.ts`** adds a local `/// `. **`oxlint-plugin-t3code`** and **`scripts`** remove catalog **`@types/bun`**; **`scripts`** also drops **`@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk`**. Root **`package.json`** adds a **`tc`** alias for typecheck; lockfile bumps **`@effect/tsgo`** and **`@typescript/native-preview`** and trims unused catalog entries. > > Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit caa0e02a7c02707c799329b2032d829c12baabaa. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot). > [!NOTE] > ### Replace `Effect.catch` fallbacks with `Effect.orElseSucceed` across the codebase > Replaces all instances of `Effect.catch(() => Effect.succeed(value))` with the equivalent `Effect.orElseSucceed(() => value)` across desktop, server, relay, and script code. This is a pure refactor with no behavioral change — `Effect.orElseSucceed` is the idiomatic Effect-TS API for recovering from any failure with a success value. > > > > Macroscope summarized caa0e02. > >
title: Refactor recoverable Effect fallbacks to orElseSucceed
